question: According to the IMF’s World Economic Outlook released in April 2025, what is India's projected economic growth rate for the year 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6.2%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** is an international organization that provides economic projections and financial assistance to member countries. Its **World Economic Outlook** is published regularly and includes global economic trends and forecasts.
 
• In the **April 2025 edition** of the World Economic Outlook, the IMF projected **India's economic growth rate for the year 2025** to be **6.2%**. This projection highlights the strength of India's economy as one of the fastest-growing major economies globally.
 
• The growth rate of **6.2%** reflects India's sustained recovery and development after economic challenges posed by the global pandemic and other external factors.
 
• The projected growth rate is an important indicator for policymakers and businesses, as it provides insights into the country's economic direction and potential investment opportunities.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 6.2%.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IMF's World Economic Outlook:**

 
 
• The **World Economic Outlook** is a flagship report published by the IMF, providing global economic analysis and forecasts.
 
• It is released twice a year – in **April and October** – and includes data on GDP growth, inflation, fiscal policies, and trade.
 
• The report is widely used by governments, businesses, and financial institutions as a reliable source for economic planning and decision-making.
 
 
 
• **India's Economic Growth:**
 
 
• India has consistently been one of the fastest-growing major economies in the world, driven by factors such as a large working population, robust domestic demand, and structural reforms.
 
• The growth projection of **6.2%** for 2025 reflects the country's ability to maintain stability and resilience despite global challenges like inflation and geopolitical tensions.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Economic Growth Rates:**
 
 
• Economic growth rates indicate the pace at which a country's economy is expanding, measured as the percentage increase in GDP over a specific period.
 
• Higher growth rates are associated with better employment opportunities, increased investments, and improved living standards.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Factors Influencing India's Economic Growth:**

 
 
• **Government policies:** Initiatives like Make in India, Digital India, and structural reforms like GST have stimulated economic growth.
 
• **Global trade dynamics:** India's position as a key player in international trade impacts its economic performance positively.
 
• **Foreign investments:** Increased foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows contribute to industrial growth and infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Other Projections in the World Economic Outlook:**
 
 
• The World Economic Outlook also provides projections for other countries and regions, highlighting global economic recovery trends or challenges.
 
• For 2025, the report might discuss the impact of major economic policies, geopolitical scenarios, and climate change on global and regional growth.
